shared_elements: a row of repeated identical motifs along one edge (three lobed shapes at top of A; arcaded petal band at base of B)
curved/rounded forms (disc-like boss in B; rounded animal bodies and disc in A)
justification: Both are stone reliefs organised by horizontal bands with a strip of repeated identical motifs running along one margin, and both use incised hatching as filler, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they are wholly unlike: A is a coarse, weathered pillar with schematic animal figures in shallow, irregular relief, whereas B is a crisply cut, compass-precise wheel and geometric ornament rendered with mechanical regularity in much higher, smoother relief.
